This suggests the management opportunity sits across discharge planning and post-acute utilization, not just inpatient authorization.\", \"explanation\": {\"reimbursement\": {\"summary_table\": {}, \"individual_policies\": []}, \"claims\": {\"summary\": \"VA acute hospital PPO Local added +$0.7M with 46 more admissions and essentially flat paid per admit.
